changed_stage: Each butterfly keeps a redundant word below 2p and avoids correcting its fixed Shoup product.
arithmetic: For a<2p<2^32 the approximate Shoup quotient underestimates by at most one. Represent addition and subtraction modulo 2p in unsigned words. A Montgomery product with at most one redundant operand satisfies a*b<p*2^32.
domain: Variable pointwise multiplication canonicalizes one input. Inverse output is canonical before the existing CRT encoder reads it.
CPU_qualification: Boundary products and overflowing sums for all 171 actual primes
Compiled butterfly intermediates checked below 2p and against direct odd-root evaluations
Six complete polynomial products with independent negacyclic output
